question: The salary decreased by 25%. If the original salary was Rs. 60000, find the new salary.
explanation: Decrease = 25%. So the remaining value is 75% of the original. | \[\Rightarrow 100\%-25\%=75\%\] | 75% can also be written as the fraction 3/4. | \[\Rightarrow 75\%=\frac{3}{4}\] | Now take 75% of the original salary. | \[\Rightarrow \text{New salary}=60000\times\frac{75}{100}=45000\] | So the new salary is Rs. 45000. | \[\Rightarrow \text{New salary}=45000\]

question: After a 20% decrease, the value became 640. Find the original value.

question: An expenditure of Rs. 30000 decreases by 15% every year. Find the expenditure after 3 years.
explanation: Each decrease of 15% leaves 85% of the expenditure. | \[\Rightarrow 100\%-15\%=85\%\] | Since the same decrease happens for 3 periods, use the retained factor 3 times. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Overall factor}=\left(\frac{85}{100}\right)^{3}\] | Now multiply the current expenditure by this overall factor. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Final expenditure}=30000\times\left(\frac{85}{100}\right)^{3}=18423.75\] | So the expenditure after 3 periods is Rs. 18423.75. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Final expenditure}=18423.75\]

question: The salary decreased by 10%. If the original salary was Rs. 40000, find the new salary.
explanation: Decrease = 10%. So the remaining value is 90% of the original. | \[\Rightarrow 100\%-10\%=90\%\] | 90% can also be written as the fraction 9/10. | \[\Rightarrow 90\%=\frac{9}{10}\] | Now take 90% of the original salary. | \[\Rightarrow \text{New salary}=40000\times\frac{90}{100}=36000\] | So the new salary is Rs. 36000. | \[\Rightarrow \text{New salary}=36000\]

question: A salary of Rs. 60000 decreased by 20%. Find the decrease amount only.
explanation: Only the reduced part is needed here. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Decrease amount}=20\%\text{ of }Rs. 60000\] | 20% can also be written as the fraction 1/5. | \[\Rightarrow 20\%=\frac{1}{5}\] | So find 20% of the original salary. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Decrease amount}=60000\times\frac{20}{100}=12000\] | So the decrease amount is Rs. 12000. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Decrease amount}=12000\]

question: After a 25% decrease, the value became 450. Find the original value.
explanation: After a decrease of 25%, the new value becomes 75% of the original. | \[\Rightarrow 75\%\rightarrow450\] | 75% can also be written as the fraction 3/4. | \[\Rightarrow 75\%=\frac{3}{4}\] | First find the value of 1% by dividing 450 by 75. | \[\Rightarrow 1\%=\frac{450}{75}=6\] | Now multiply the value of 1% by 100 to get the original value. | \[\Rightarrow 100\%=6\times100=600\] | So the original value was 600. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Original value}=600\]

question: Find the decrease multiplier for a 15% decrease in the salary.

question: A salary of Rs. 20000 first decreased by 15% and then by 10%. Find the final salary.

question: A price decreased first by 20% and then by 15%. Find the overall percentage decrease.
explanation: Convert both decreases into retained factors. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Combined factor}=\frac{80}{100}\times\frac{85}{100}\] | This combined factor shows what fraction of the original still remains. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Combined factor}=\frac{80}{100}\times\frac{85}{100}=0.68\] | So subtract the remaining fraction from 1 and convert it into percent. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Net decrease}=32\%\] | So the overall percentage decrease is 32%. | \[\Rightarrow \text{Net decrease}=32\%\]
